summary: Add Query().field.between(low, high) method for inclusive range queries, composable with &, |, ~, cache-compatible, matching SQL BETWEEN semantics (no match when low > high, missing fields don't match).

acceptance_criteria.given: a TinyDB instance with documents containing an 'age' field
acceptance_criteria.then: returns a list of documents where 18 <= age <= 65
returns a callable that accepts two arguments (low, high) and returns a query object
returns only documents with price exactly 10.00
returns a valid query object that matches documents satisfying both conditions
returns a valid query object that matches documents satisfying either condition

acceptance_criteria.given: a TinyDB instance with caching enabled (CachingMiddleware)
acceptance_criteria.then: the second call returns the same result and uses the cache (verified by cache hit or execution time)

acceptance_criteria.given: the TinyDB public API before the change
acceptance_criteria.when: importing tinydb and inspecting Query class
acceptance_criteria.then: only the 'between' method is added; no existing methods are removed or changed

acceptance_criteria.given: a benchmark of existing query operations
acceptance_criteria.when: running the same benchmark after adding between
acceptance_criteria.then: performance of existing queries (==, >=, <=, &, |, ~) is not measurably degraded

assumptions.assumption: between(low, high) with low > high matches no documents (SQL BETWEEN semantics)
Cache key for between(low, high) may differ from expanded form (field >= low) & (field <= high); both are independently cacheable
